summary: Ansible gathers facts at the start of each play by default. You can turn this off with gather_facts: false at the play level to improve scalability, especially with very large numbers of hosts.
questions: How do I skip fact gathering to make my play faster?
Where do I put gather_facts: false?
Does disabling facts help with huge inventories?

answer_card.title: Turning off fact gathering
answer_card.answer_md:
Set `gather_facts` on the play:

```yaml
- hosts: whatever
  gather_facts: false
```

This helps performance with very many hosts, or when you already know everything about your systems.
